description:
[Trading Data API] Fair Value Gap zones (standard ICT/LuxAlgo) with CE (50%), gap size, age, fill status, distance from price. Standard timeframes match TradingView candles. Crypto or stocks.

**Example:** `/v1/fvg?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

Use when you want Fair Value Gap zones (ICT-style imbalances) with fill status and distance from price. Not for swing-high/low liquidity pools (use liquidity_levels).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

include_filled.description: Optional. true to include filled FVGs (default false = active only).

lookback.description: Optional. Timeframe candles to analyze (default 120, max 500).

min_gap_pct.description: Optional. Filter out gaps smaller than this % of price (default 0 = all).

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, NVDA, SPY (or any with &class=).

name: fvg
